---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for PassCraft
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. I am frustrated when...).

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Proposed UI / Settings Changes**
Describe how this feature would look or be accessed in the extension interface (e.g. new toggle, slider, dropdown).

**Privacy & Security Considerations**
Does this feature involve any storage or data handling? *(Reminder: PassCraft strictly operates 100% offline with zero external network calls).*

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockups, or examples from other tools here.
